objective: Fix the call spread rather than delete it (v8 deleted it and lost bear protection). Apply the SYMMETRIC trend gate: v5 already refuses to sell PUT-side premium when a symbol is below its 200-day SMA (downtrend); v9 additionally refuses to sell CALL-side premium when a symbol is ABOVE its 200-day SMA (uptrend). Never sell premium in the direction the trend is running.

diagnosis_that_motivated_it.finding: In v5, call spreads lost -$913 over 7 years with an 85% win rate: avg win $35 vs avg loss $217 (6x). The losses concentrated in the highest-momentum names of the era -- SMH -$629, GLD -$597, XLY -$419, QQQ -$266, XBI -$227 -- while slow/defensive names (SPY +$417, TLT +$339, LQD +$202, XLV +$210) were fine.
diagnosis_that_motivated_it.interpretation: Short calls were repeatedly run over by sustained uptrends (AI/semis, the gold bull, Nasdaq). This is the exact mirror of the 2022 put-side failure that motivated v4/v5.
diagnosis_that_motivated_it.mechanism: Selling premium against a durable trend is the losing side of a trend; the v5 gate already encodes this for puts. v9 simply completes the symmetry -- it is not a new idea, it is the missing half of an existing validated one.

change_from_v5.only_change: CALL_SPREAD additionally requires spot <= its 200-day SMA (symbol NOT in an uptrend). Put spreads and iron condors keep the existing v5 put-side gate (spot >= SMA200). Everything else identical.
change_from_v5.note_on_condors: The iron condor keeps only the put-side gate in this variant so the change is attributable to the call-spread rule alone. A condor-specific dual gate would be a separate experiment.

falsifiable_predictions: call-spread PnL improves from -$913 toward or above breakeven
2022 is NOT materially worse than v5's -$2,802 (unlike v8, the bear-side structure is retained, just better timed)
call-spread trade count falls substantially (most of the sample was an uptrend)

guardrails.no_p_hacking: Registered ONCE; the rule (200-day, symmetric) is fixed and inherited from the already-validated v5 put-side gate, not swept. If it fails we keep v5 and report it.
guardrails.gate_unchanged: PBO<0.5 AND DSR>0 fixed. Fewer trades raise the deflation bar.
guardrails.same_deviations: Proxied IV, constant-IV repricing, model credit -> UPPER BOUND.

trial_accounting.note: same universe/structures; a gate refinement, no new search breadth.

promotion: No promotion. SHADOW. Informs whether the live desk should gate call spreads on trend.
